# EmptyState

Figma: [05d. EmptyState](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-925) · Family: 05 Feedback · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-06-07

Placeholder content shown when a list, view, or section has no items to display. EmptyState IS the content - it occupies the empty area and gives the user a clear next step. 12 variants encode 3 tones × 2 sizes × 2 directions. Vertically centered layout with a real Isocons illustration on a subtle concentric-circles backdrop, bold title, muted description, optional primary action button (Global_Design_System Button), and optional secondary link. Illustrations and buttons are nested instances - designers swap them via the standard Figma "Swap instance" UI for any custom Isocon, button label, or link target. NEW in Syntropy v2.0 (no direct legacy counterpart).

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/empty-state/reference.png`

### EmptyState

Centered placeholder that replaces content when a list or view has nothing to show after loading: illustration, title, description, optional primary Button and link. Tone default (nothing yet), search (no matches) or error (failed to load).

Level: organism · Contains: Empty Illustration / default / Default, Button, Link · Part of: Chart / States

Use when:
- No investments yet in the portfolio, with a Browse deals button
- Filters return no deals (Tone=search, Clear filters)
- Deals failed to load (Tone=error, Retry)
- No open deals right now, explained so it does not look broken

Don't use when:
- While data is still loading: use SkeletonLine, SkeletonBlock and friends
- Feedback about an action the user just took: use Toast or Alert
- A chart with no data inside a chart card: use Chart / States State=empty

Accessibility: Title as a heading; the button must have a clear verb label; the illustration is decorative.

### Illustrations

Library of 33 isometric Safqah Isocon illustrations (lifecycle phases plus themes like Bank, Face ID, Light bulb, Diamond, Info), each with Right or Left alignment, used as artwork in empty states and feature moments.

Level: atom · Part of: EmptyState

Use when:
- Swapping the illustration inside EmptyState to fit the context (Bank for no linked account)
- Feature intro or onboarding cards that need a Safqah-style illustration
- Face ID or biometric prompts (Face ID variants)
- Pick Alignment to match the layout direction

Don't use when:
- Small status glyphs inside a status badge: use illustrations (on the badge page)
- UI icons in buttons or lists: use the Syntropy icon set
- Brand logos: use SafqahLogo

Accessibility: Decorative; mark aria-hidden and let adjacent text carry the message.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

EmptyState is shown when a list, view, or section has no items to display. Unlike notifications (Alert, Toast, Banner) which overlay on top of content, EmptyState IS the content. It occupies the empty area, explains why nothing is there, and offers the user a clear next step. Three tones encode the type of emptiness: default (nothing here yet), search (no results match the query), error (something went wrong). Each tone uses a real Isocon illustration drawn by a designer in Illustrator, sitting on a subtle concentric-circles backdrop.

### When to reach for EmptyState

- A list view that has no items yet ("No deals in your portfolio", "No notifications yet").
- Search or filter results return zero matches ("No results for 'compound interest'").
- A data fetch fails with no fallback content ("Could not load deals").
- A new feature or section is launching with no content yet ("Your wishlist is empty").
- Permissions or access state results in no visible items ("No deals available for your investor tier").

### When NOT to use EmptyState

- Loading states - use Skeleton (05e) instead. EmptyState is for AFTER the load completes with zero items.
- In-page notifications about something the user just did - use Toast (05b).
- Persistent contextual help that appears alongside other content - use Alert (05a).
- Form validation errors - use Alert with error tone.

### Sample tones

### Anatomy

EmptyState has up to five elements arranged vertically and centered: illustration container, title, description, primary action button, secondary link. The layout is horizontally and vertically centered in its parent container, which is what gives EmptyState its "I AM the content" presence.

### Elements

- Illustration container: a 240×240 (Default size) or 160×160 (Compact size) frame containing a concentric-circles backdrop (3 nested ellipses with fading opacity) and a real Isocon illustration scaled via rescale() so strokes stay crisp. Each tone has its own default Isocon (see Tones below). The illustration is a nested COMPONENT instance - designers swap it via Figma's "Swap instance" UI to use any other Isocon or a custom illustration.
- Title (title TEXT): bold tone-colored text. The single most important message. 20px in Default, 16px in Compact. Always present.
- Description (description TEXT, controlled by showDescription BOOLEAN): regular muted text. One sentence explaining the state and pointing toward the next step. 14px Default, 13px Compact. Default ON.
- Button: a Global_Design_System Button instance (Type=primary, Size=large for Default, Size=MD for Compact) - controlled by showButton BOOLEAN. Default OFF. To change the button label, drill into the nested instance and update its "Button Title" property. Same for state and other Button properties.
- Link (linkText TEXT, controlled by showLink BOOLEAN): semibold muted text below the button. Default OFF. Use for secondary actions like "Learn more" or "Get help".

> **Info:** There is no close icon. EmptyState IS the content - it cannot be dismissed. Once the user creates an item, performs a search, or successfully loads data, the EmptyState is replaced by the actual content. There is nothing to "close".

### Tones

Three tones encode the type of empty state. Pick the tone based on what caused the empty state, not what looks nice. Each tone has its own default Isocon illustration from the user-uploaded illustrations set.

Tone = default

Default Isocon: Scheduled (camera)

Use for first-time emptiness - the user has not created or received anything yet. The default Isocon is the "Scheduled" camera, conveying "ready for something to happen but nothing yet". Primary action invites the user to take their first step ("Get started", "Create your first goal", "Browse deals"). The Isocon can be swapped for any other illustration that better matches the specific domain.

Tone = search

Default Isocon: Preparing (purple coin grid)

Use when a query or filter returns no matches. The default Isocon is the "Preparing" purple coin pattern, conveying "looking through items". Primary action helps the user broaden their search ("Clear filters", "Try a different search").

Tone = error

Default Isocon: Defaulted (pink crossed-out circle)

Use when a data fetch fails or a system error prevents content from loading. The default Isocon is the "Defaulted" pink crossed-circle, conveying "blocked / not accessible". Primary action invites a retry ("Try again", "Refresh").

> **Warning:** The default Isocons (Scheduled, Preparing, Defaulted) are deal-lifecycle illustrations from the Safqah Isocons set, repurposed as placeholders. They're semantic stretches - Scheduled doesn't literally mean "no items yet". For a tighter semantic fit, drop dedicated empty-state Isocons (empty-box, magnifier-no-results, broken/disconnected) into the same Isocons set and swap them in via the nested-instance UI.

### Sizes

Two sizes pick the visual prominence based on how much screen real estate the EmptyState owns.

Size = Default

Full-area EmptyState. 480px wide, 240px illustration container with the Isocon scaled to 132px, 20px title, 14px description, Button size=large. Use when the EmptyState fills a major content area - a tab, a page section, the main view of a screen. The larger size makes the empty area feel intentional rather than broken.

Size = Compact

Smaller EmptyState. 360px wide, 160px illustration container with the Isocon scaled to 88px, 16px title, 13px description, Button size=MD. Use when the EmptyState sits inside a card, modal, sidebar, or other constrained surface where the Default size would feel oversized.

### In context - common patterns

Four canonical Safqah EmptyState patterns showing each tone in a real product scenario.

### Pattern 1: First-time portfolio (default tone)

A new investor opens the portfolio tab and has not invested in anything yet. Default tone with a clear CTA to browse deals. Default size to fill the portfolio area. Designer drills into the nested Button to set "Browse deals" as the title.

### Pattern 2: Search/filter no results (search tone)

User applied filters to the deals list and no deals match. Search tone with a "Clear filters" CTA. Compact size because it sits below the filter chips in a constrained card.

### Pattern 3: Network error with retry (error tone)

The deals fetch fails due to a network error. Error tone with a "Retry" button. Default size because the error replaces the entire deals view. Designer also enables showLink to expose "Contact support" as a secondary action.

### Pattern 4: Arabic RTL goals empty (default tone)

Saudi-market Arabic Goals tab with no goals set yet. Default tone, Arabic copy overridden per-instance, Direction=RTL for Noto Sans Arabic and right-aligned title.

### Properties guide

EmptyState exposes 6 properties: 3 TEXT for content, 3 BOOLEAN for visibility. The illustration and button are nested instances - they expose their OWN properties (which can be overridden by drilling into them in the right-side panel).

### TEXT properties (3)

title  ·  TEXT

Default: "No items yet"

Bold tone-colored title. Always present. Keep it scannable - one short sentence describing the state. Avoid generic openings like "Sorry," or "Oops,".

description  ·  TEXT

Default: "When you create your first item it will appear here."

One sentence of supporting context that points toward the next step. Hide via showDescription=false for title-only EmptyStates.

linkText  ·  TEXT

Default: "Learn more"

Secondary link below the button. Use for "Learn more", "Get help", "Contact support". Only visible when showLink=true.

### BOOLEAN properties (3)

showDescription  ·  BOOLEAN

Default: true

Toggle the description. Hide for title-only EmptyStates where the title carries the full message.

showButton  ·  BOOLEAN

Default: false

Toggle the primary action button (a nested Global_Design_System Button instance). Almost always enable for EmptyState - the whole point is to give the user a next step. Only hide for purely informational empty states.

showLink  ·  BOOLEAN

Default: false

Toggle the secondary link below the button. Use for "Get help" or "Learn more" pointers.

### Nested instance properties (not exposed at the set level)

> **Info:** The illustration and button are nested instances. To change the button label, drill into the nested Button instance and update its "Button Title" property. To change the illustration, drill into the nested illustration instance and use the right-panel "Swap instance" UI. These are standard Figma patterns for nested components - they are NOT exposed as top-level EmptyState properties because Figma's API does not support arbitrary parent→child TEXT or INSTANCE_SWAP property forwarding through component instances.

> **Warning:** NOTE: In earlier versions (v3) there was a `buttonLabel` TEXT property on EmptyState. It was removed in v4 because Figma cannot forward a parent TEXT property to a nested Button instance's "Button Title" property. Designers update button text by drilling into the nested instance.

### Code examples - Flutter

### Basic usage

```dart
// Default empty portfolio
const SyntropyEmptyState(
  tone: EmptyStateTone.default_,
  title: 'No deals in your portfolio yet',
  description: 'Browse open deals to make your first investment.',
  buttonLabel: 'Browse deals',
  onButtonTap: navigateToDeals,
)

// Search no results (compact, inside a card)
const SyntropyEmptyState(
  tone: EmptyStateTone.search,
  size: EmptyStateSize.compact,
  title: 'No deals match your filters',
  description: 'Try widening the price range or clearing your filters.',
  buttonLabel: 'Clear filters',
  onButtonTap: clearAllFilters,
)

// Network error with retry + help link
const SyntropyEmptyState(
  tone: EmptyStateTone.error,
  title: 'Could not load deals',
  description: 'Check your connection and tap retry.',
  buttonLabel: 'Retry',
  onButtonTap: refetchDeals,
  linkText: 'Contact support',
  onLinkTap: openSupportChat,
)

// Arabic RTL
SyntropyEmptyState(
  tone: EmptyStateTone.default_,
  direction: TextDirection.rtl,
  title: 'لم تحدد أي هدف بعد',
  description: 'حدد هدفك المالي الأول لبدء رحلتك في الاستثمار.',
  buttonLabel: 'أنشئ هدفاً',
  onButtonTap: createGoal,
)
```

### Implementation sketch

```dart
enum EmptyStateTone { default_, search, error }
enum EmptyStateSize { default_, compact }

class SyntropyEmptyState extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final String? description;
  final String? buttonLabel;
  final String? linkText;
  final EmptyStateTone tone;
  final EmptyStateSize size;
  final TextDirection direction;
  final Widget? customIllustration;
  final VoidCallback? onButtonTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLinkTap;

  const SyntropyEmptyState({
    super.key,
    required this.title,
    this.description,
    this.buttonLabel,
    this.linkText,
    this.tone = EmptyStateTone.default_,
    this.size = EmptyStateSize.default_,
    this.direction = TextDirection.ltr,
    this.customIllustration,
    this.onButtonTap,
    this.onLinkTap,
  });

  Widget _defaultIllustration() => switch (tone) {
    EmptyStateTone.default_ => const IsoconScheduled(),
    EmptyStateTone.search => const IsoconPreparing(),
    EmptyStateTone.error => const IsoconDefaulted(),
  };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = SyntropyTheme.of(context);
    final compact = size == EmptyStateSize.compact;
    final containerSize = compact ? 160.0 : 240.0;
    final isoconSize = compact ? 88.0 : 132.0;
    
    return Directionality(
      textDirection: direction,
      child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: compact ? 24 : 32,
          vertical: compact ? 32 : 48,
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            // Illustration container (concentric backdrop + Isocon)
            SizedBox(
              width: containerSize, height: containerSize,
              child: Stack(alignment: Alignment.center, children: [
                ConcentricBackdrop(size: containerSize),
                SizedBox(
                  width: isoconSize, height: isoconSize,
                  child: customIllustration ?? _defaultIllustration(),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: compact ? 12 : 16),
            Text(title, textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: compact ? theme.text.semibold16 : theme.text.semibold20),
            if (description != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(description!, textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: compact
                  ? theme.text.regular13.copyWith(color: theme.text.muted)
                  : theme.text.regular14.copyWith(color: theme.text.muted)),
            ],
            if (buttonLabel != null) ...[
              SizedBox(height: compact ? 12 : 16),
              SyntropyButton.primary(
                size: compact ? SyntropyButtonSize.md : SyntropyButtonSize.large,
                label: buttonLabel!,
                onTap: onButtonTap,
              ),
            ],
            if (linkText != null) ...[
              SizedBox(height: compact ? 8 : 12),
              GestureDetector(
                onTap: onLinkTap,
                child: Text(linkText!,
                  style: theme.text.semibold13.copyWith(color: theme.text.muted)),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** EmptyState is NEW in Syntropy v2.0. The legacy Global_Design_System had no dedicated empty state component - empty lists were handled ad-hoc with manually-placed icons, text, and buttons. Migration is forward-only.

> **Warning:** Illustrations are real Isocons from the user-uploaded illustrations set (2071:38797). Current defaults: Scheduled camera (default), Preparing purple coins (search), Defaulted pink X-circle (error). These are deal-lifecycle Isocons being repurposed as placeholders - semantically they don't perfectly map to "no items yet" or "no search results". For tighter semantic fit, drop dedicated empty-state Isocons (empty box, magnifier no-results, broken/disconnected) into the same Isocons set and swap them in via the nested-instance UI.

> **Info:** Each illustration component (in the on-page Illustration Library 2083:630) is the SOURCE of truth for that tone+size pairing. To update what default illustration appears for, say, the "error / Default" combo across all RTL+LTR variants, update the source component. Changes propagate automatically through the 12 variants via their nested instances.

> **Warning:** Isocons are scaled via instance.rescale(factor) NOT instance.resize(w,h). This is critical - resize() does not scale stroke weights, so the Isocon would render as washed-out thin lines at large sizes. rescale() scales geometry AND strokes proportionally, preserving the designer's intended look.

> **Info:** The button is a Global_Design_System Button instance (Type=primary, Size=large for Default EmptyState, Size=MD for Compact). To change the button label, state, or icon, drill into the nested Button instance and update its properties directly. The EmptyState set does NOT expose a buttonLabel property because Figma cannot forward a parent TEXT property to a nested instance's TEXT property via componentPropertyReferences.

> **Warning:** TEXT property defaults show the default tone copy ("No items yet" / "When you create your first item..."). For search and error tones, designers MUST override the title and description with tone-appropriate copy (e.g. "No results found" / "Could not load"). The reference frame demonstrates this with canonical overrides per tone.

> **Info:** EmptyState IS the content, not a notification. It cannot be dismissed (no close icon). Once the underlying state changes - the user creates an item, runs a different search, or the data successfully loads - the EmptyState is replaced by the actual content.

> **Tip:** Almost always enable showButton. The whole point of EmptyState is to give the user a clear next step. An EmptyState without an action button is essentially a "sad face" - it tells the user something is missing but does not help them resolve it.

> **Warning:** For loading states, use Skeleton (05e, DEFERRED). EmptyState is for AFTER the load completes with zero items.
